mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in the last two months indicates a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and higher corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the last month indicates a robust supply-side response, which is a positive signal for economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the last three months signals strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points within the last month, it signals a tightening labor market with strong job growth, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it signals an inflationary environment with tight monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% in the last quarter signals a weakening economy, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
